article.title: New York plays Milwaukee, seeks 4th straight home win
article.linkText: New York plays Milwaukee, seeks 4th straight home win
article.story: Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. New York Knicks (5-4, fifth in the Eastern Conference) New York; Tuesday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: New York will try to keep its three-game home win streak intact when the Knicks take on Milwaukee. New York went 53-29 overall and 35-17 in Eastern Conference action last season. The Knicks averaged 116.5 points per game while allowing opponents to score 110.1 last season. Milwaukee went 32-50 overall and 21-31 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Bucks averaged 110.6 points per game while allowing opponents to score 116.8 last season. INJURIES: Knicks: Josh Hart: day to day (ankle). Bucks: Kam Jones: day to day (ankle), Gary Trent Jr.: out (illness). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
